definition: Core box minus exported material/proxy union. Current detailed Pi assembly contributes a conservative interval, not a completed exact occupied union. Cooling air, cable/service clearance and omitted flexible material are within this empty-model volume; it is not removable waste.
qualification: Conservative CAD proxy-volume interval, rounded outward to whole cm3; source/kernel and baseline representation caveats remain. The slow/unreliable complete CSI Boolean was stopped and preserved as a diagnostic. No physical measurement or precise unused-volume claim.
interval_definition: After subtracting the non-Pi material union and simple PCB, upper bound removes no further Pi material; lower bound subtracts the sum of every remaining Pi source-solid volume, including overlaps and any material outside the core. Actual union subtraction must lie between these CAD bounds. No raw compound sum is claimed as occupied volume.
comparison_caveat: The candidate uses source-corrected Pi geometry while baseline retains its original approximate proxy. Void differences include that representation change, not only packaging changes.
